Count actual/predicted label pairs.

Emits observed label pairs with raw counts and values normalized by actual label, predicted label, or all valid rows.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Analytics](../categories/analytics.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `ConfusionMatrixNode` |
| Search words | confusion, matrix, evaluation |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Data** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Input table |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Matrix** | Dataset | No | 1 | Observed actual/predicted pairs with count and value |

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| actual_col | `actual_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Actual label column. Required. |
| predicted_col | `predicted_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Predicted label column. Required. |
| normalize | `normalize` | Choice | `none` | `none`, `true`, `pred`, `all` | The run | none=count; true=by actual; pred=by predicted; all=by all rows. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).
